text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 4_Para: With oil of joy from your fellows.
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 5_Para: Bar Yochai! With oil of sacred anointment
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 6_Para: were you anointed from the holy measure
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 7_Para: You bore the headplate, a crown of holiness,
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 8_Para: bound upon your head is your glory.
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 9_Para: Bar Yochai! You were anointed – you are fortunate –
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 10_Par: With oil of joy from your fellows.
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 11_Par: Bar Yochai! In a goodly dwelling did you settle
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 12_Par: on the day you ran, the day you fled,
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 13_Par: In rocky caves where you stopped –
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 14_Par: there you acquired your glory and your strength.
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 15_Par: Bar Yochai! You were anointed – you are fortunate –
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 16_Par: With oil of joy from your fellows.
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 17_Par: Bar Yochai! Like standing shittim beams,
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 18_Par: the teachings of God they study
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 19_Par: An extraordinary light is the light of the fire
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 20_Par: that they kindle – they, your teachers, will teach you.
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 21_Par: Bar Yochai! You were anointed – you are fortunate –
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 22_Par: With oil of joy from your fellows.
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 23_Par: Bar Yochai! You came to a Field of Apples
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 24_Par: and entered it to pick confections:
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 25_Par: The mystery of Torah with blossoms and flowers –
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 26_Par: ‘Let us create man’ was said because of You.
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 27_Par: Bar Yochai! You were anointed – you are fortunate –
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 28_Par: With oil of joy from Your fellows.
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 29_Par: Bar Yochai! You were girded with strength,
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 30_Par: and in the war of the fiery Torah up to the gate
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 31_Par: You pulled a sword from its scabbard,
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 32_Par: you drew it against your enemies.
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 33_Par: Bar Yochai! You were anointed – you are fortunate –
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 34_Par: With oil of joy from your fellows.
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 35_Par: Bar Yochai! To a place of marble stones,
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 36_Par: you arrived, and before a huge lion.
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 37_Par: Even a rounded crown upon a constellation’s star
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 38_Par: you perceived – but none can perceive you.
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 39_Par: Bar Yochai! You were anointed – you are fortunate –
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 40_Par: With oil of joy from your fellows.
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 41_Par: Bar Yochai! In the Holy of Holies,
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 42_Par: a green line creates new manifestations
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 43_Par: Seven weeks are the secret of the fifty,
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 44_Par: you bound the bonds of Shin as your bonds.
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 45_Par: Bar Yochai! You were anointed – you are fortunate –
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 46_Par: With oil of joy from your fellows.
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 47_Par: Bar Yochai! The Yud of earliest wisdom,
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 48_Par: you gazed into its innermost honor,
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 49_Par: The thirty-two paths of the very first tithe,
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 50_Par: you are like a cherub anointed with the glow
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 52_Par: Bar Yochai! You were anointed – you are fortunate –
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 53_Par: With oil of joy from your fellows.
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 54_Par: Bar Yochai! At a wondrous light in lofty heights
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 55_Par: you feared to stare for it is great.
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 56_Par: Such hiddenness that one calls her, ‘Naught’.
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 57_Par: You declared that no eye could glimpse You.
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 58_Par: Bar Yochai! You were anointed – you are fortunate –
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 59_Par: With oil of joy from your fellows.
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 60_Par: Bar Yochai! Fortunate is she who bore you,
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 61_Par: fortunate is the people that learns from you,
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 62_Par: And fortunate are those who can plumb your mystery,
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 65_Par: Bar Yochai! You were anointed – you are fortunate –
text.7_Lag BaOmer Songs, 3_Bar Yochai, 66_Par: With oil of joy from your fellows.
